After Postman variable substitution, the body renders as `"credentialsSelector" : UAE,` - a bare unquoted token - which is invalid JSON; the request is expected to fail at the JSON-parsing layer (client-side send error or a server-side parse-error response), not merely an authorization failure. View Test Case
Preconditions
Access to a non-production environment for this test; awareness that a positive result must be escalated immediately
Steps
  1. [Search] POST with isdebug=true -> inspect supplierRequest/supplierResponse; repeat with isdebug=false; repeat with isdebug omitted -> compare presence/absence of the two fields across all three runs
Expected Result
With isdebug=true, supplierRequest/supplierResponse are present and may contain raw upstream SOAP/XML; the AirArabia observed example's supplierResponse contained apparent live supplier SOAP credentials (wsse:Username/wsse:Password) in plaintext -- any such exposure must be flagged explicitly. Behavior of isdebug=false/omitted is UNKNOWN and must be confirmed live.
Actual Result
3 of 8 calls returned the raw supplierRequest (3 with plaintext supplier credentials); isdebug=false / omitted returned none (5 calls). V1 isdebug=true: supplierRequest RETURNED with plaintext username/password (values masked) | V1 isdebug=omitted: supplierRequest not returned | V2 isDebug=true: supplierRequest RETURNED with plaintext username/password (values masked) | V2 isDebug=false: supplierRequest not returned | V2 isdebug=true: supplierRequest RETURNED with plaintext username/password (values masked) | V1 isdebug=false: supplierRequest not returned | V2 isdebug=false: supplierRequest not returned | V2 isdebug=omitted: supplierRequest not returned

Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Bundle, Hold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Target environment confirmed non-production, or production Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized per the Section 2.9 Testing Note, since this flow commits a live booking. Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> Hold (send (getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate; script-enforced price check) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged + surName; script-enforced price check) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=held) -> BookAfterHold (send pnr, gdsPNR/gdsPnr, bookingToken -- no passenger data resent; capture pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR and ASSERT they are IDENTICAL to Hold's values, same-PNR invariant, 2.13; script-enforced price check) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus transitions held->booked/confirmed)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family D): bookingStatus transitions from held (after Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold) to booked/confirmed (after BookAfterHold), with pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR identical to the values Hold produced (same-PNR invariant, SPEC.md Section 2.13). Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line. Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow.
Actual Result
Not executable on AirIndia: the chain needs Hold / BookAfterHold / FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice) / Void / CancelAfterHold / Upselling / FareCheck / FareRules / SeatAfterHold, which AirIndia does not support (live: 409 OperationNotSupported on V1 and V2, see the TC-AIEGY-*-NEG-01 cases for each endpoint; supplier matrix lists them N/A). Independently, no inventory is returned (TC-AIEGY-CAP-01).

Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo.
Actual Result
Blocked: AirIndia/EGY returns no bookable inventory on ne-3 (every valid Search, V1 and V2, returns HTTP 200 with an empty offers[]; about 1,600 searches, 0 offers - see TC-AIEGY-CAP-01/02/05). The offerId / ResponseId this case depends on cannot be produced.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Ancillary, Hold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Tester is prepared to log the resulting pnr in the Family-B dangling-Hold tracking sheet, since this flow intentionally stops at a held (uncommitted) state (Section 5.2/6.3). Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- offerHasAncillary/isAncillaryRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (send the same current ID pair (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate; price-reconciliation IS script-enforced for V2 Hold, 2.10) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (send pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged + surName; re-validate price -- script-enforced in both versions, 2.12) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=held, holdExpirationDate present and future; MANUAL price-reconciliation check -- V2 Retrieve not script-enforced) -- FLOW STOPS HERE by design (Family B); log pnr for cleanup/expiry tracking
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family B): bookingStatus reads a held (not yet ticketed) state with holdExpirationDate present and in the future at the final Retrieve -- the flow deliberately STOPS here (Family B, no BookAfterHold/CancelAfterHold), leaving a dangling Held booking; log the pnr for out-of-band cleanup/expiry tracking per SPEC.md Section 6.3. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo.
Actual Result
Not executable on AirIndia: the chain needs Hold / BookAfterHold / FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice) / Void / CancelAfterHold / Upselling / FareCheck / FareRules / SeatAfterHold, which AirIndia does not support (live: 409 OperationNotSupported on V1 and V2, see the TC-AIEGY-*-NEG-01 cases for each endpoint; supplier matrix lists them N/A). Independently, no inventory is returned (TC-AIEGY-CAP-01).

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Bundle, Ancillary, Hold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Tester is prepared to log the resulting pnr in the Family-B dangling-Hold tracking sheet, since this flow intentionally stops at a held (uncommitted) state (Section 5.2/6.3). Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true, offerHasAncillary/isAncillaryRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (send the same current ID pair (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate; price-reconciliation IS script-enforced for V2 Hold, 2.10) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (send pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged + surName; re-validate price -- script-enforced in both versions, 2.12) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=held, holdExpirationDate present and future; MANUAL price-reconciliation check -- V2 Retrieve not script-enforced) -- FLOW STOPS HERE by design (Family B); log pnr for cleanup/expiry tracking
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family B): bookingStatus reads a held (not yet ticketed) state with holdExpirationDate present and in the future at the final Retrieve -- the flow deliberately STOPS here (Family B, no BookAfterHold/CancelAfterHold), leaving a dangling Held booking; log the pnr for out-of-band cleanup/expiry tracking per SPEC.md Section 6.3. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line; passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo.
Actual Result
Not executable on AirIndia: the chain needs Hold / BookAfterHold / FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice) / Void / CancelAfterHold / Upselling / FareCheck / FareRules / SeatAfterHold, which AirIndia does not support (live: 409 OperationNotSupported on V1 and V2, see the TC-AIEGY-*-NEG-01 cases for each endpoint; supplier matrix lists them N/A). Independently, no inventory is returned (TC-AIEGY-CAP-01).

FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Blocked: AirIndia/EGY returns no bookable inventory on ne-3 (every valid Search, V1 and V2, returns HTTP 200 with an empty offers[]; about 1,600 searches, 0 offers - see TC-AIEGY-CAP-01/02/05). The offerId / ResponseId this case depends on cannot be produced.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Bundle, SeatMap, Hold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Tester is prepared to log the resulting pnr in the Family-B dangling-Hold tracking sheet, since this flow intentionally stops at a held (uncommitted) state (Section 5.2/6.3). Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true, isSeatMapRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetSeatMap (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs are auto-captured here -- manually record the chosen seatMapDetails cellCode [e.g. "1A"] on paper/in the test log, since it must be hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries Seat category; this manual-carry step is a documented tester-error risk point, 2.7) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (send the same current ID pair (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate; price-reconciliation IS script-enforced for V2 Hold, 2.10) -> FareConfirmAfterHold/PnrReprice (send pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged + surName; re-validate price -- script-enforced in both versions, 2.12) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=held, holdExpirationDate present and future; MANUAL price-reconciliation check -- V2 Retrieve not script-enforced) -- FLOW STOPS HERE by design (Family B); log pnr for cleanup/expiry tracking
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family B): bookingStatus reads a held (not yet ticketed) state with holdExpirationDate present and in the future at the final Retrieve -- the flow deliberately STOPS here (Family B, no BookAfterHold/CancelAfterHold), leaving a dangling Held booking; log the pnr for out-of-band cleanup/expiry tracking per SPEC.md Section 6.3. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line; the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Not executable on AirIndia: the chain needs Hold / BookAfterHold / FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice) / Void / CancelAfterHold / Upselling / FareCheck / FareRules / SeatAfterHold, which AirIndia does not support (live: 409 OperationNotSupported on V1 and V2, see the TC-AIEGY-*-NEG-01 cases for each endpoint; supplier matrix lists them N/A). Independently, no inventory is returned (TC-AIEGY-CAP-01).

submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> GetSeatMap (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs are auto-captured here -- manually record the chosen seatMapDetails cellCode [e.g. "1A"] on paper/in the test log, since it must be hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries Seat category; this manual-carry step is a documented tester-error risk point, 2.7) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Book (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = the most-current ID pair (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, voidCapability; MANUAL price-reconciliation check here -- V2 Book's script does not enforce it, 2.9/6.2) -> Retrieve (send pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; ASSERT bookingStatus=booked/confirmed, selectedOffer matches Book's; MANUAL price-reconciliation check here too -- V2 Retrieve has zero script assertions, 2.11/6.2)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family A): bookingStatus reads a booked/confirmed state at the final Retrieve, with selectedOffer.offerId/priceDetails.totalAmount matching between Book and Retrieve. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Blocked: AirIndia/EGY returns no bookable inventory on ne-3 (every valid Search, V1 and V2, returns HTTP 200 with an empty offers[]; about 1,600 searches, 0 offers - see TC-AIEGY-CAP-01/02/05). The offerId / ResponseId this case depends on cannot be produced.

Supplier_Name + Credentials_Selector chosen and confirmed live-capable for this flow's Required Capabilities (Ancillary, SeatMap, Hold) via the Section 4.7 pre-flow confirmation procedure (Search then FareConfirm, inspecting haveBundles/canBeHeld/offerHasAncillary/isSeatMapRequired on the live offer) -- do not rely on the static Section 4.2/4.6 matrix alone. Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Target environment confirmed non-production, or production Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized per the Section 2.9 Testing Note, since this flow commits a live booking. Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- offerHasAncillary/isAncillaryRequired=true, isSeatMapRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> GetSeatMap (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs are auto-captured here -- manually record the chosen seatMapDetails cellCode [e.g. "1A"] on paper/in the test log, since it must be hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries Seat category; this manual-carry step is a documented tester-error risk point, 2.7) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (send (fareCheckOfferId + its responseId, if FareCheck ran; otherwise getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID); capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate; script-enforced price check) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged + surName; script-enforced price check) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus=held) -> BookAfterHold (send pnr, gdsPNR/gdsPnr, bookingToken -- no passenger data resent; capture pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR and ASSERT they are IDENTICAL to Hold's values, same-PNR invariant, 2.13; script-enforced price check) -> Retrieve (ASSERT bookingStatus transitions held->booked/confirmed)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family D): bookingStatus transitions from held (after Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold) to booked/confirmed (after BookAfterHold), with pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR identical to the values Hold produced (same-PNR invariant, SPEC.md Section 2.13). Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Not executable on AirIndia: the chain needs Hold / BookAfterHold / FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice) / Void / CancelAfterHold / Upselling / FareCheck / FareRules / SeatAfterHold, which AirIndia does not support (live: 409 OperationNotSupported on V1 and V2, see the TC-AIEGY-*-NEG-01 cases for each endpoint; supplier matrix lists them N/A). Independently, no inventory is returned (TC-AIEGY-CAP-01).

Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.

Collection-scoped variables (searchResponseId, offerId, fareConfirmResponseId, getAddPaxOfferId/getAddPaxResponceID, ANCofferId/ANCresponseId, pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, etc.) reset/cleared before starting so no stale ID carries over from a prior flow run (Section 6.1). Tester is prepared to log the resulting pnr and confirm via a follow-up manual Retrieve that CancelAfterHold actually released the hold, since this endpoint has zero script coverage (Section 2.14). Caution: do not select AirCairo, EgyptAir, Galileo, or SpiceJet for Hold-dependent capabilities without live confirmation -- their Hold support conflicts across SPEC.md source documents (Section 4.4); GLC is confirmed Hold=Not Supported by both sources. Indigo/ElJazeera/OmainAir capability lookups are affected by a known name-mismatch bug (Section 4.5) -- "no data" for these three is not evidence of "unsupported".
Steps
  1. Search (send searchCriteria/passengers; capture responseId->searchResponseId, offers[0].offerId->offerId per the offers[0] test-script convention, SPEC.md 2.1) -> FareConfirm (send ResponseId=searchResponseId [V2 field-name difference vs V1's searchResponseId, 2.2], selectedOfferId=offerId; capture fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; ASSERT capability flags on selectedOffer relevant to this flow -- haveBundles=true, offerHasAncillary/isAncillaryRequired=true, isSeatMapRequired=true -- these live per-offer flags are authoritative over the static Section 4.2 capability matrix, 2.1/2.2) -> GetOfferBundles (send ResponseId=fareConfirmResponseId, selectedOfferId=fareConfirmSelectedOfferId; select a bundleCode from bundleChoices and record it manually for later use in selectedBundles -- do NOT rely on the script's JourneyKey1 capture, it is dead/undefined due to a documented resp.offerJourneys.key script bug, 2.4; IDs pass through UNCHANGED, no new ID minted here) -> AddPassenger (send ResponseId/selectedOfferId = FareConfirm's own IDs [even though GetOfferBundles ran in between, Bundle mints no new IDs, so AddPassenger still consumes FareConfirm's pair directly, 2.4/3.2]; submit passengersList {title,name,nationality,residentCountry,birthDate,gender,passengerTypeCode,contactRefId,travelDocument,ParentPaxRefId for any INF} + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID [collection's own "Responce" typo] -- these SUPERSEDE FareConfirm's IDs for every subsequent V2 step, 2.5) -> GetAncillary (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCofferId, ANCresponseId; ASSERT and record isFareCheckRequired [drives whether FareCheck below is mandatory]; note passengersAncillariesAvailabilty is genuinely misspelled in the live API's own JSON [missing 2nd "i"] -- any strict field-name assertion must match the misspelling exactly, 2.6) -> GetSeatMap (send ResponseId=getAddPaxResponceID, selectedOfferId=getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs are auto-captured here -- manually record the chosen seatMapDetails cellCode [e.g. "1A"] on paper/in the test log, since it must be hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries Seat category; this manual-carry step is a documented tester-error risk point, 2.7) -> FareCheck -- CONDITIONAL: only mandatory if the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true (2.6/2.8); if required, send selectedOfferId=ANCofferId, ResponseId=ANCresponseId, PassengersSelectedAncillaries keyed by pax ref with AncillaryCode values copied VERBATIM from GetAncillary's segmentsAncillariesDetails[].code [opaque gzip+base64 tokens, never hand-construct] plus the seat cellCode if SM in scope; capture fareCheckOfferId; NOTE selectedOffer.offerId returned here OVERWRITES fareConfirmSelectedOfferId, and the collection's commented-out responseId propagation line means it is a documented soft spot which responseId Book/Hold should use next -- verify live, 2.8) -> Hold (capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR unchanged) -> Retrieve (ASSERT held) -> CancelAfterHold (send pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken; zero script coverage on this endpoint in either collection, 2.14; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a cancelled/terminated bookingStatus -- this is entirely manual/unscripted, treat as the weakest-validated endpoint in the API)
Expected Result
Per-family state check (SPEC.md 6.3, Family F): bookingStatus transitions from held to a cancelled/terminated state after CancelAfterHold -- CancelAfterHold has zero script coverage and no genuine saved response example anywhere in the collections, so this is the weakest-validated end-state in the whole API; treat the post-CancelAfterHold Retrieve bookingStatus as the primary, entirely-manual success signal. Per-enrichment state check(s) (SPEC.md 6.4): the booking's final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the selected bundle's feePrice added to the base offer price, and any bundle-included service (baggage/seat/meal per includedServices tags) does NOT also appear as a separately-priced ancillary line; passengersSelectedAncillaries on Book/Hold/Retrieve lists exactly the ancillary codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck time with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity, and paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of the selected ancillaries' prices; the chosen GetSeatMap cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per what GetSeatMap/FareCheck reported for that cell; the final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total (not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total) -- the highest-value price-integrity assertion for this enrichment. FareCheck conditionality: FareCheck must actually run only if the immediately-preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap response reported isFareCheckRequired=true; do not treat FareCheck as unconditionally present, and if it is required, the price delta between the pre-FareCheck and post-FareCheck totals should equal the sum of the selected ancillary/seat prices (2.8). Manual price-reconciliation requirement (V2 script coverage gap, SPEC.md 1.4/2.1/6.2/7.10): per passenger type, sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount, and totals reconcile per the Section 2.1 formula; this is enforced by script at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold in V2, but NOT at Search/FareConfirm/Book/Retrieve -- the tester must supply this check manually at every Book/Retrieve step in this flow. Assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty (GetAncillary response) is spelled exactly as the live API returns it -- missing the second "i" -- since this is a genuine API field-name defect, not a documentation typo. Assert the GetSeatMap-selected cellCode was correctly hand-carried into Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries; a mismatched or omitted cellCode is the single most likely manual-execution error in flows 49-72.
Actual Result
Not executable on AirIndia: the chain needs Hold / BookAfterHold / FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice) / Void / CancelAfterHold / Upselling / FareCheck / FareRules / SeatAfterHold, which AirIndia does not support (live: 409 OperationNotSupported on V1 and V2, see the TC-AIEGY-*-NEG-01 cases for each endpoint; supplier matrix lists them N/A). Independently, no inventory is returned (TC-AIEGY-CAP-01).

Preconditions
Supplier/credentialsSelector chosen and capability-confirmed per §4.7 for: Upsell, Bundle, Ancillary, SeatMap, Hold, Void. Collection variables reset/clean at flow start (§6.1). Non-production environment, or Book/BookAfterHold explicitly authorized if this flow reaches it.
Steps
  1. Search (capture searchResponseId, offerId) -> Upselling (capture upSellingResponseId, upSellingSelectedOfferId; manually treat as ResponseId/selectedOfferId for the next call, since the collection auto-chains fareConfirmResponseId/fareConfirmSelectedOfferId instead) -> GetOfferBundles (consume substituted Upselling IDs; select a bundle code manually; IDs pass through unchanged; do not rely on JourneyKey1 for chaining - its resp.offerJourneys.key read is broken against the real response shape) -> AddPassenger (consume prior step's ResponseId/selectedOfferId [substituted Upselling IDs]; submit passengersList + contactsList; capture getAddPaxOfferId, getAddPaxResponceID - supersedes all prior IDs for every subsequent V2 step) -> GetAncillary (consume getAddPaxResponceID/getAddPaxOfferId; capture ANCresponseId, ANCofferId, isFareCheckRequired; assert passengersAncillariesAvailabilty field name exactly as misspelled in the live response) -> GetSeatMap (consume getAddPaxResponceID/getAddPaxOfferId; no IDs auto-captured - manually record the chosen cellCode for Book/Hold's PassengersSelectedAncillaries) -> FareCheck (only if isFareCheckRequired=true from the preceding GetAncillary/GetSeatMap; consume ANCresponseId/ANCofferId; AncillaryCode copied verbatim from GetAncillary - never hand-constructed; overwrites fareConfirmSelectedOfferId and sets fareCheckOfferId; verify which responseId Book/Hold actually need afterward, given the commented-out propagation line) -> Hold (consume current ResponseId/selectedOfferId; confirm {{Credentials_Selector}} resolves correctly given V2 Hold's known casing defect; manually verify price reconciliation per script; capture pnr, bookingToken, gdsPNR, holdExpirationDate) -> FareConfirmAfterHold (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; verify price reconciliation and that holdExpirationDate has not yet passed) -> Retrieve (consume pnr/bookingToken/gdsPNR; verify bookingStatus reflects a held state, holdExpirationDate still future) -> BookAfterHold (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; verify same-PNR invariant and price reconciliation; bookingStatus transitions to booked/confirmed) -> Retrieve (verify bookingStatus reflects booked/confirmed state, pnr unchanged from Hold) -> Void (consume pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken/surName; verify voidCapability allowed the action on the now-finalized booking; a follow-up manual Retrieve should show a voided bookingStatus)
Expected Result
Family-D checks apply, plus Family-C's Void checks applied to the now-finalized (ex-Held) booking. Bundle check: final priceDetails.totalAmount reflects the chosen bundle's feePrice; bundle-included services are not also charged as separate ancillary lines. Ancillary check: passengersSelectedAncillaries lists exactly the codes selected at GetAncillary/FareCheck with matching AdditionalServiceCategory/quantity; paxTotalAncillaryAmount equals the sum of selected ancillary prices. SeatMap check: the chosen cellCode appears as a Seat-category entry in passengersSelectedAncillaries, priced per GetSeatMap/FareCheck. FareCheck check: final booking price equals FareCheck's re-priced total, not the pre-ancillary FareConfirm/AddPassenger-era total. Manual price-reconciliation must be supplied at Hold/FareConfirmAfterHold/BookAfterHold (V2 enforces this by script only there) and additionally checked by hand at Search/Upselling/Book/Retrieve since no script covers those in V2.
Actual Result
Not executable on AirIndia: the chain needs Hold / BookAfterHold / FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice) / Void / CancelAfterHold / Upselling / FareCheck / FareRules / SeatAfterHold, which AirIndia does not support (live: 409 OperationNotSupported on V1 and V2, see the TC-AIEGY-*-NEG-01 cases for each endpoint; supplier matrix lists them N/A). Independently, no inventory is returned (TC-AIEGY-CAP-01).

Findings11Defects4Unknown-resolution

Defect — BUG-01 (new)

AirIndia/EGY returns no offers on any route or date: 1,618 one-way searches (India domestic, Gulf, Egypt, Europe, North America, Asia, Africa; both directions; 12 departure dates from 2026-11-12 to 2027-09-30; V1 and V2) all returned HTTP 200 with an empty offers[] (SPEC.md 4.6 AirIndia, TC-AIEGY-CAP-02)

Field: offers[] (Search, supplier AirIndia / credentialsSelector EGY)


Expected value: At least one route/date returns offers[] with offerId and priceDetails (e.g. DEL-BOM on any date with scheduled flights)


Impact: No flow can be executed for AirIndia: Book, Retrieve, Bundles, Ancillary and SeatMap are all unreachable, so the supplier cannot be regression-tested or sold on ne-3 See full bug report.


Evidence: TC-AIEGY-CAP-01 (V1 and V2 DEL-BOM), TC-SEARCH-POS-01, TC-AIEGY-CAP-02 (1,618 searches, 0 with offers)




Defect — BUG-02 (new)

When the supplier leg fails, Search stalls for a fixed ~15 s and then answers HTTP 200 with an empty offers[] (no error, no supplierResponse). With isdebug=true the only supplier call visible is the login request; it never returns a response and no availability request is ever sent (SPEC.md 2.1, 7.14, TC-AIEGY-CAP-05)

Field: Search response (HTTP 200, offers: [])


Expected value: A prompt technical/supplier error (for example 502/503 or 409 with a mapped ErrorCode such as supplier authentication failed / supplier unavailable), not a successful empty result


Impact: A caller cannot tell "no flights" from "supplier down or credentials rejected"; operations will treat an outage as sold-out and no alert fires See full bug report.


Evidence: Every one of 1,618 valid searches took 15.1-16.0 s (mean 15.1 s) while invalid input on the same endpoint is rejected in about 0.1 s (TC-AIEGY-CAP-04, CAP-05)




Defect — BUG-03 (new)

Search with isdebug=true returns the raw supplierRequest to the caller, and for AirIndia it contains the supplier login credentials (username, password and domain) in plaintext, on V1 and V2 (isdebug=false or omitted returns nothing) (SPEC.md section 2.1, section 7.14, TC-SEARCH-SEC-01)

Field: supplierRequest (Search with isdebug=true)


Expected value: supplierRequest / supplierResponse are never returned to the caller, or at least credentials are masked (for example "password": "***")


Impact: Anyone holding the shared x-api-key can read live AirIndia credentials by adding isdebug=true to a Search See full bug report.


Evidence: TC-SEARCH-SEC-01: 3 of 8 calls returned supplierRequest with plaintext credentials (values masked in every artifact of this run)




Defect — BUG-04 (new)

Ordinary 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 error responses (no isdebug) carry OriginalSupplierRequest with the supplier login credentials in plaintext. Reproduced on V1 Retrieve, V2 Retrieve and V1 FareConfirm; a failed call is enough to leak them (SPEC.md 7.14, TC-AIEGY-SEC-02)

Field: OriginalSupplierRequest / OriginalSupplierResponse (error responses)


Expected value: Error responses never include raw supplier payloads or credentials; OriginalSupplierRequest / OriginalSupplierResponse omitted or null


Impact: Credential disclosure without any special flag: every supplier timeout on these calls hands the caller the AirIndia login See full bug report.


Evidence: TC-AIEGY-SEC-02: 3 of 3 calls returned OriginalSupplierRequest (90 characters, credentials structure, values masked)




Defect — BUG-05 (new)

V1 FareConfirm does not validate the search id locally: a never-issued or wrongly named id (ResponseId instead of searchResponseId) is forwarded to the supplier and the call hangs about 135 s before returning 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 "Connection timed out". V1 and V2 Retrieve of an unknown PNR hang the same ~135 s. V2 FareConfirm rejects the same input in 0.4 s with 400 "selected offer is invalid" (SPEC.md section 2.2, section 7.1, TC-FARECONFIRM-VAL-01)

Field: searchResponseId / selectedOfferId (V1 FareConfirm, V1 and V2 Retrieve)


Expected value: 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 within about a second ("selected offer is invalid, expired or could not be found"), as V2 FareConfirm does; Retrieve of an unknown PNR returns a mapped not-found error


Impact: A bad id ties up a request thread for over two minutes and surfaces as an unmapped Z9999; clients will time out first See full bug report.


Evidence: TC-FARECONFIRM-VAL-01 (V1 134.7 s), TC-AIEGY-FARECONFIRM-NEG-01 (V1 135.9 s), TC-AIEGY-RETRIEVE-NEG-01 (V1 137.1 s, V2 135.3 s), TC-AIEGY-SEC-02




Defect — BUG-06 (new)

V1 Book and V1 GetOfferBundles return HTTP 500 ServerError ("Unknown error occured") for a never-issued fareConfirmResponseId/selectedOfferId pair, for a missing fareConfirmResponseId and for a 1000-character selectedOfferId, where V2 Book and V2 GetOfferBundles return 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 (SPEC.md section 2 (Book), section 7.7, TC-AIEGY-BOOK-NEG-01)

Field: V1 Book and V1 GetOfferBundles (unknown or missing id)


Expected value: 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 "selected offer is invalid, expired or could not be found" (the V2 behaviour)


Impact: A bad id on the booking path looks like a platform outage; support cannot tell caller error from server fault See full bug report.


Evidence: TC-AIEGY-BOOK-NEG-01, TC-AIEGY-BOOK-NEG-03, TC-BOOK-NEG-12, TC-BOOK-VAL-01, TC-BOOK-VAL-02, TC-AIEGY-GETOFFERBUNDLES-NEG-01/02/03, TC-AIEGY-CHAIN-02




Defect — BUG-07 (new)

Search accepts a party of one child with no adult (CHD 1) and a party of 10 that is over the 9-passenger limit only because of infants (6 ADT + 2 CHD + 2 INF); both return HTTP 200 on V1 and V2, while 10 seated passengers, an infant alone and more infants than adults are rejected with 400 (SPEC.md section 2.1, TC-AIEGY-SRCH-PAX-03)

Field: passengers[] (Search validation)


Expected value: 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 for both parties (an adult is required; the 9-passenger cap counts infants)


Impact: Invalid parties reach the supplier (and cost a 15 s supplier round trip) and would fail later at Book See full bug report.


Evidence: TC-AIEGY-SRCH-PAX-03 (CHD only), TC-AIEGY-SRCH-PAX-06 (10 with infants)




Defect — BUG-08 (new)

Client errors use two different envelopes: model-binding validation failures return camelCase {status, errorCode "1001", errorMessage, context[], originalSupplierRequest: null} while business validation and auth use PascalCase {Status, ErrorCode "NDC-INT-TEC-A0001" / "AuthenticationError" / "OperationNotSupported" / "NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999"}. Over 570 4xx responses: about 300 camelCase vs 260 PascalCase (SPEC.md section 2.1 (Expected Failure Responses), section 7.9, section 8.1 item 2, TC-VERSIONDIFF-NEG-01)

Field: error envelope (status/ErrorCode/ErrorMessage casing and codes)


Expected value: One envelope with one casing, for example {"Status":400,"TransactionId":"...","ErrorCode":"NDC-INT-TEC-A0001","ErrorMessage":"...","Context":[...]} for every client error


Impact: Clients need two parsers; error-code mapping breaks silently See full bug report.


Evidence: TC-VERSIONDIFF-NEG-01 (Search, FareConfirm and Book differ by cause), TC-AIEGY-ENV-01 (census)




Defect — BUG-09 (new)

Validation errors expose internal implementation detail: .NET type names (System.DateTime, System.Guid, System.Int32, NDC.Integrations.Application.Dtos.Api.Supplier), JSON path with line and byte position, and the exception class name SocketException. A bad supplier value also returns the misleading text "The airSearchRequestDto field is required." although the DTO is present (SPEC.md 7.14, TC-AIEGY-SEC-LEAK-01)

Field: context[].value (validation errors)


Expected value: A neutral message naming the field, for example "supplier must be one of the supported suppliers", with no type names or parser positions


Impact: Information disclosure that helps an attacker fingerprint the stack; misleading messages slow integrators down See full bug report.


Evidence: TC-AIEGY-SEC-LEAK-01: about 126 of 666 captured responses contain such detail




Defect — BUG-10 (new)

The same unsupported multi-city Search ("The supplier does not support multi city searches") returns HTTP 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 on V1 but HTTP 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 (the unmapped catch-all code) on V2 (SPEC.md 2.1, TC-AIEGY-EXP-01)

Field: Search error code for unsupported multi-city


Expected value: The same status and mapped ErrorCode on both versions (400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001)


Impact: V2 callers cannot distinguish a known business limitation from an unknown supplier failure See full bug report.


Evidence: TC-AIEGY-EXP-01, TC-AIEGY-SRCH-SC-09




Defect — BUG-11 (new)

Hold, BookAfterHold, PnrReprice, CancelAfterHold, Void, Upselling, FareCheck, FareRules and SeatAfterHold reject AirIndia with 409 OperationNotSupported and the context text "AirIndia does not exists" on V1 and V2, before any id is looked at. The unsupported-operation behaviour matches the supplier matrix (N/A) but the message reads like a missing-supplier registration error (SPEC.md section 2 (Hold), section 7.7, TC-AIEGY-HOLD-NEG-01)

Field: Context[0].Value on OperationNotSupported


Expected value: 409 OperationNotSupported with a message such as "Hold is not supported for supplier AirIndia"


Impact: Integrators and support read it as a configuration fault and may open false incidents; it also hides whether the supplier name is mapped correctly (compare the Indigo / ElJazeera name-mismatch bug in SPEC 4.5) See full bug report.


Evidence: TC-AIEGY-UPSELLING/HOLD/PNRREPRICE/BOOKAFTERHOLD/CANCELAFTERHOLD/VOID/FARECHECK/FARERULES/SEATAFTERHOLD-NEG-01




Unknown-resolution

AirIndia credential selectors on ne-3: EGY is active; UAE and KSA return 400 "The credentials for the selected supplier do not exist or are not active" with the same text on V1 and V2. Supplier name and selector matching ignore case and surrounding whitespace (airindia, AIRINDIA, " AirIndia", egy, "EGY " all accepted) (TC-AIEGY-CAP-03)



Unknown-resolution

Live AirIndia capability on ne-3 (V1 and V2): Hold, BookAfterHold, FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice), CancelAfterHold, Void, Upselling, FareCheck and FareRules are not supported (409 OperationNotSupported); SeatAfterHold likewise. FareConfirm, AddPassenger, GetAncillary, GetSeatMap, Book, GetOfferBundles and Retrieve are routed (id lookup reached). So only terminal Family A (Book then Retrieve) can ever run for AirIndia; Families B-F (Hold, Void, Cancel) cannot (TC-AIEGY-HOLD-NEG-01)



Unknown-resolution

Error baseline observed on ne-3: 400 camelCase code 1001 (model binding), 400 PascalCase NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 (business validation, inactive credentials, offer not found), 401 AuthenticationError ("Invalid authorization header") for an altered or missing x-api-key and for an altered Client-Id, 405 for GET/PUT/DELETE on Search, 409 OperationNotSupported, 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 (supplier timeout, multi-city on V2), 500 ServerError (V1 Book and V1 GetOfferBundles with unknown ids) (TC-VERSIONDIFF-NEG-01)



Unknown-resolution

Search does not validate that an IATA code exists or is upper case: origin XXX and del return 200 with an empty offers[] on V1 and V2. A departure date of today or 2028-12-01, an unknown preferredAirlines value (XX), an extra unknown body field and a 2 MB body are all accepted (200). Duplicate segments and multi-city are rejected with 400 (TC-SEARCH-NEG-03)
